import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class mainF {
    public static Scanner enter = new Scanner(System.in);
    public static PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
    public static long mod = 998244353;
    public static long[] fact = new long[4002];
    public static long[] invFact = new long[4002];
    public static long[] pow2 = new long[2002];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Precompute factorials
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < fact.length; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % mod;
        }
        // Precompute inverse factorials using Fermat
        invFact[fact.length - 1] = binPow(fact[fact.length - 1], mod - 2, mod);
        for (int i = fact.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFact[i] = invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod;
        }
        // Precompute powers of 2
        pow2[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < pow2.length; i++) {
            pow2[i] = pow2[i - 1] * 2 % mod;
        }

        int n = enter.nextInt();
        int k = enter.nextInt();
        long l = enter.nextLong() % mod;

        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = k; i <= n; i++) {
            long tmp = 0;
            for (int s = 0, sign = 1; s <= n - i; s++, sign = -sign) {
                long term = comb(n - i, s) * pow2[s] % mod;
                term = term * fact[s + i] % mod;
                term = term * fact[s + i] % mod;
                term = term * invFact[2 * (s + i) + 1] % mod;
                tmp = (tmp + sign * term) % mod;
            }
            long add = comb(n, i) * pow2[i] % mod * tmp % mod;
            ans = (ans + add) % mod;
        }
        ans = ans * l % mod;
        System.out.println((ans + mod) % mod);
    }

    public static long comb(int n, int k) {
        if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0;
        return fact[n] * invFact[k] % mod * invFact[n - k] % mod;
    }

    public static long binPow(long a, long b, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) res = res * a % mod;
            a = a * a % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
}

            b >>= 1;
